description.value: Tim Hortons is a major Canadian quick-service chain serving freshly brewed coffee, baked goods, soups, and full breakfast and lunch options. This Sparwood location is a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Elk Valley, offering dine-in seating and a full food menu. The location also features a drive-through and WiFi.
